title: Behind the scenes: the team can take away or give back a member's portal access (switched off)
text: On a company page, each person in Contacts now shows where they stand with the client portal, and the team has one button to take the company away from a member or give it back. The person always stays an owner on every document; only the portal changes. Making a login by hand, and the messages and notices that pick one person, now skip a member who has no portal access. It is switched off, so nothing changes yet: we test it on test companies first and Antonio turns it on afterwards.
points: Chip per person: Portal login active, Login after EIN, No login yet, No portal access
Take away access / Give access, with the team member recorded
The primary contact and the last person with access cannot be taken away

steps.name: Open the company page
steps.detail: Contacts shows a chip for each person.

steps.name: Press Take away access or Give access
steps.detail: The person stays an owner either way.

steps.name: Give access finishes the job
steps.detail: Creates the login and sends the welcome email when none exists (admins only).
